lyrics:
[Intro: marching piano figure, soft kick]

[Verse 1: female voice, worried]
You fell asleep at eight again
The dishes and the news still on
We haven't had a conversation
That wasn't schedules since the fall
I lie here doing the arithmetic
Of when we last were us at all

[Pre-Chorus: female, drums entering]
Tell me that it's still in there
Tell me I'm not making it up

[Chorus: both voices, full band]
Tired isn't over
Quiet isn't gone
We're not broken, baby, we're just behind on sleep
And it's been so long
Give me a morning, one slow morning, and we'll count again
Tired isn't over
We just have to get to the weekend

[Verse 2: male voice, gentle, a little amused]
You've been reading into silence
I've been dead on my two feet
I still look at you in the kitchen
When you think I'm half asleep
I know the nights have all been short ones
You're still the one I'd stay up to keep

[Pre-Chorus: male, drums pushing]
It's still in there, I swear it is
You're not making it up

[Chorus: both voices, full band]
Tired isn't over
Quiet isn't gone
We're not broken, baby, we're just behind on sleep
And it's been so long
Give me a morning, one slow morning, and we'll count again
Tired isn't over
We just have to get to the weekend

[Bridge: piano alone, voices trading]
Your mother takes the kids on Friday
We turn our phones face down
I'll make the coffee. You sleep till ten.
And then we look around.

[Final Chorus: key up a step, both voices at full strength]
Tired isn't over
Quiet isn't gone
We're not broken, baby, we're just behind on sleep
And it's been so long
Give me a morning, one slow morning, and we'll count again
Tired isn't over
We just have to get to the weekend

[Outro: piano figure, a yawn, a laugh]
